name: ID Generator
description: Generate UUID, ULID, snowflake IDs and NanoID in one place.

hints.format: UUID suits distributed identifiers, ULID is time-sortable, snowflake IDs fit database keys and NanoID is short with no special characters.
hints.output: The random source for UUID and NanoID is the Tongsuo CSPRNG.

faq.a: Within one node the sequence separates IDs in the same millisecond; use different node IDs across deployments.
Choose ULID when you need time ordering or a readable prefix; choose UUID for uniqueness alone.
